detail.longDescription: Well, well… # WallStreet took a giant dump today as the # StockMarket finally freaked out about # AI debt vs. profits, the backlash against # DataCenters , and the general public disregard for # TechBros - who lost big in the mid-term elections and are now facing scrutiny. Some will attempt to characterize this stunning decline as a reaction to the prospect of Democrats governing, but that’s BS, a deflection. No, this slide is entirely due to a loss of investor confidence in the ability of the # Tech sector to deliver on its promises in the current environment. That, plus the outrageous amount of private, off-the-books credit that is underpinning the # ArtificialIntelligence buildout. Is this the start of the bubble bursting? It’s too early to tell imo. But it is obvious markets are spooked, so there’s that. # investing # finance
